usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and SMS Manager by BulkSMS receives contacts and texts through “Create Contact” and “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in SMS Manager by BulkSMS
bestTemplate.why: Phone numbers from abandoned checkouts become contacts you can text later.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so contacts arrive after a scheduled check.
